rationale: The mapping explicitly proposes an unresolved comparative expectation. Establishing that relation would license the claim; observing the specification change after contact or recording matrix ratings alone would not establish it. The mapping acknowledges that narrow specifications and prior contact may be routine.
signal_basis: The observable is the filled matrix: a comparative pattern showing which hypotheses accumulate inconsistent items, which items discriminate, and which conclusions shift under the sensitivity test. It is not any single document.
stated_empirical_relation: - A specification narrowed to match one bidder's attributes, dated after a documented contact with that bidder, would be more expected under H1 or H5 than under H2.
